exceptions.reason: The part writes the attribute names that the docs list, and CSS selects them as text. The family has no namespace of constants (rule 8.10).
`CheckboxGroup.test.ts` tests the value, the parent checkbox, the disabled state, the form values, the field and the label of the group, with the native checkboxes.
The group holds the state of its parent checkbox. The cases of the parent in `CheckboxGroup.test.ts` test the cycle, the disabled children and `aria-controls`.
The state of the group has no `focused`: CSS selects `:focus-within` (rule 8.15). A Boolean prop of Vue is `false` when the developer does not give it, so `disabled` has no default of its own.
The part writes the attribute names that the docs list, and CSS selects them as text. The family has no namespace of constants (rule 8.10).

relocations.behavior: The presses of the parent checkbox cycle all, none and the last mixed selection, and a disabled child keeps its state.
